sentences.text: The conditions are reproduced below:-
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that because of condition No.2 the Finance Company is not complying the condition No.1 and adjusting the loan amount from the sale amount.
The loan amount is increasing day by day and value of the vehicle is decreeing day by day.
3. Learned counsel for the Finance Company submits that condition No.2 is very harsh and because of condition No.2 the Finance Company has decided not to sale the vehicle and recover the loan amount.
4. The applicant is owner of the vehicle which was seized by the police for the offence punishable under Section 406, 420, 468, 471, 473 and 201 of IPC.
In this criminal case, the petitioner is not accused.

None of charges against him and on these charges,
even if proved this vehicle is not likely to be confiscated to recover any amount or loss.
The vehicle was found in possession of accused, who was is claiming ownership before the Court and no application under Section 452 or 459 of Cr.P.C. was filed by him.
Admittedly, the applicant is registered owner of the vehicle and vehicle was found in the commission of offence by using the forge number plate by the accused person.
Thus condition No.2 of order dated 12.12.2019 is hereby relaxed.
The Finance Company is directed to sale the vehicle and adjust the loan amount within 30 days and submit the information to the trial court.
With the above observation and direction, Criminal Revision is disposed of.
